Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_LootSpawnMul: Controls how often Energy Routing mod items appear in loot (x0.25, x0.5, x1, x3, x5).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ConsumerScan: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_ControllerVe: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
Sandbox_EnergyRoutingSystem_DebugLogs_to: Enables verbose ERS console logging for debugging. Keep disabled on servers to avoid spam.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_LootSpawnMultiplie: Controls how often Energy Routing mod items appear in loot (x0.25, x0.5, x1, x3, x5).
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ConsumerScanInterv: How often the controller performs a periodic full consumer cache refresh. Dirty events still force an immediate refresh.
Sandbox_EnergyRouting_ControllerVertical: How many floors above and below the controller are included for energy distribution and consumer scans (0 = same floor only).
